summary: Iteration 45 frontend-only review of Unibox unified status card. Logged in as super admin (dhruvmathur208@gmail.com) which has 3 IMAP-unconfigured inboxes — perfect for verifying the 'issues' branch. All 12 acceptance criteria pass: compact unibox-status-card renders at top above filters, shows 'Receiving Accounts: 0 / 3', amber variant active, issues-summary '3 accounts require attention.', view-issues-btn opens issues-dialog with 3 issue-account-* items (each labelled 'Not Receiving' with detail text), issues-close closes the dialog, issues-refresh closes dialog AND re-fetches /api/unibox/status + /api/unibox/replies, top refresh-unibox also re-fetches both endpoints, filter-account still lists all 3 accounts (regression intact), mobile 390px viewport has no horizontal overflow and View Issues wraps to its own row. Confirmed via DOM scan that old testids account-status-grid and account-status-* are FULLY REMOVED. Code review of Unibox.jsx confirms no residual references.
critical_code_review_comments: Unibox.jsx is ~793 lines and ~13 useState hooks; exceeds the recommended 700-line threshold. Consider extracting the issues dialog, DNE dialog, save-to-folder dialog, and the status card IIFE into separate components for maintainability. NOT blocking for this iteration — flagged for future cleanup.

Known pre-existing lint blocker on useEffect at L183-185 (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect via Promise.all of callbacks that setState). Carried over from iter-44 as flagged in the request; no regression introduced by this iteration.

Minor i18n nit: 'issues-summary' always says 'X account(s) require attention.' — grammatically uses 'require' for plural and the conditional only branches the trailing 's' on count. For count===1 the string 'account require' is grammatically off (should be 'requires'). Low priority polish.
